notes.title: Beerman Demo Update
notes.content:
The original Beerman Demo was created from a version of the game that still had some bugs in the first level and the big developer radar beam missed this on its first swing round!

This new Beerman Demo has been made from the final version of the game that had all the issues resolved in an earlier update and concerns level 1 and all of the odd things that needed ironed out, details below :


ːBeermanEmotion1ː ːBeermanEmotion2ː ːBeermanEmotion3ː ːBeermanEmotion4ː ːBeermanEmotion5ː 

[b][url=http://beermangame.com/]CLICK HERE to meet the gang at the Beerman Website!!![/url][/b]


Level 1 Updates


1. Drunk Missiles

Yes unfortunately Jamaican George's launchings did tend to drift under the helicopter as if they had been drinking.....well no longer, now the missiles launched head directly for Beerman or the helicopters nose.............Jamaican George got his aim back!


2. Beerman Blasted

It was the strange case that even with Beerman's Vietnam experience if he inadvertently smashed into another helicopter there was the possibility of him literally being blasted clear of the game screen in the resulting explosion.....this has now been fixed with it truly impossible for our hero to go AWOL.


3. Magic JaMan

In the previous builds when JaMan was preparing to throw the student to his death from the top of the building if the player was quick enough and opened the chinook ramp and killed the two guards JaMan would also be seen walking onto the aircraft with the Veggie Baddie.....

Now although JaMan is Jamaican and therefore cool enough to be in two places at once this didn't really sit well with reality so I have since revised this and now the chinook door will not open for boarding until JaMan has finished throwing the student to his death.....

Hooray for order!


This of course brings the demo inline with the main game, a little Boston clean up so the madness can continue!

notes.title: Beerman Playable App Launched on Android and Windows
notes.content:
Yes it's finally happened the Boston Mayhem has been reconfigured to run on a mobile phone both in Android hosted by Amazon App Store and Windows hosted by Windows App Store.

The process to convert it from the PC supported Unity Steam version to the Android / Windows UWP version was incredibly difficult, how hard I hear you ask?  I'll have nightmares about converting every Polyon Collider thoughout the game to Box Colliders till the end of time!!!

Initially I was not going to announce it because I didn't want to annoy the good people at Steam who took a chance on this game, and was just going to quietly work on it in the background.

However it turns out in order to make it run on an app I had to scale down the first level a bit, things like the glass coming out of windows now just disappears on the way down rather than hitting the ground and being removed by the coroners van, quirky little touches like that had to be removed or slimmed down.

Fortunately the rest of the game levels are almost identical and the video cut scenes which are completely identical so the whole point of the game - The Storyline - remains the same.

That then means Steam still hold the fastest PC supported version with all the trimmings for the hardcore gamers out there and now that the Beerman Website has had it's contacts page reconfigured to include the app addresses a new customer base is potentially on route to them.

Anyone who finds the game on Amazon App Store or on the Windows App Store will inevitably find the attached Beerman Website and since all the game buttons in the website are and will remain targeted at the Steam Website a whole bunch of folks who might not have frequented Steam will now be directed here.

So there are three winners from this process then :

1. Steam win by getting unofficial advertising on their rivals websites through the Beerman Website directing a new bunch of folks to them.

2. The fans win by getting news of one more step on this mad Boston journey.

3. And I win by getting to laugh at all the old Greenlight haters who said this game was never going to go anywhere one more time.....

Isn't Life Great!!! ːsteamhappyː

[url=http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25872138/537cb749590d4c27f96b8674b8c3cc8e5d471cd6.png][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25872138/55e1639846abfeea16ab6c228867de15d34067a8.png[/img][/url]


Beerman Amazon App Store :

https://www.amazon.co.uk/VS1-Studios-Beerman/dp/B075KDY2Q4/ref=sr_1_1?s=mobile-apps&ie=UTF8&qid=1505585448&sr=1-1&keywords=Beerman


Beerman Windows App Store :

https://www.microsoft.com/en-gb/store/p/beerman/9mx5g3mcvj3k



System Requirements :

App Tested on Nokia 930

Control -     Integrated Touch        

Architecture     -     x64, ARM

Processor        -     Snapdragon

Toggle Screen Controls On / Off - "T" key if phone has keyboard

notes.title: Beerman Latest Update
notes.content:
This update concerns level 1 and all of the odd things that needed ironed out, I would have got to it sooner but some evil lecturers insisted I do their coursework first.....details below :

Level 1 Updates


1. Drunk Missiles

    Yes unfortunately Jamaican George's launchings did tend to drift under the helicopter as if they had been drinking.....well no longer, now the missiles launched head directly for Beerman or the helicopters nose.............Jamaican George got his aim back!


2. Beerman Blasted

    It was the strange case that even with Beerman's Vietnam experience if he inadvertently smashed into another helicopter there was the possibility of him literally being blasted clear of the game screen in the resulting explosion.....this has now been fixed with it truly impossible for our hero to go AWOL.


3. Magic JaMan

    In the previous builds when JaMan was preparing to throw the student to his death from the top of the building if the player was quick enough and opened the chinook ramp and killed the two guards JaMan would also be seen walking onto the aircraft with the Veggie Baddie.....

    Now although JaMan is Jamaican and therefore cool enough to be in two places at once this didn't really sit well with reality so I have since revised this and now the chinook door will not open for boarding until JaMan has finished throwing the student to his death.....

Hooray for order! ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Beerman Update Pause/Resume
notes.content:
Hello Everyone, hope all is well with you.

Pressing " P " now at any time as the game is being played pauses the game and a small clickable resume box appears at the lower right of the screen which when clicked resumes the game.

It is at the lower right and transparent because i've noticed some great screenshots being uploaded by gamers ( Thank you they look great )
just in case anyone wishes to get screenshots for fun I refrained from putting the box in the middle of the screen with bright yellow letters as I reckoned that might ruin someone's day! 

Instead it is transparent and placed at the lower right in a an innocuous position to keep it out of the way and with a low profile.

This is also explained in the instructions menu page.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25872138/c97b942e65cdd65c9f9c3c394d4234bd45eb3564.png[/img]

The video cut scenes will soon be next for the treatment.

Happy Gaming!

notes.title: Beerman Latest Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone, responding to advice from gamers I have updated Beerman levels in the following ways :

Level 1 - The window gunners have been taken off psychopath mode and their weapons have had their power exactly halved ( Power meaning speed of exiting projectile, their impact is still one hit one life lost )


Level 3 - The Armoured Police Vehicle was according to gamers taking too much damage from incoming rounds too quickly and hence this has been revised with the vehicle now taking less damage per hit.


Hopefully these changes add to playing enjoyment, as I said balancing the levels difficulty is a tricky business when your own input can't provide the answers easily but with all your reports I think the levels are finally getting there.....many thanks to you all!

Oh and trading cards, badges and backdrops have been sent for their second review so hopefully any day now!
